_comment: Languages this site offers. Delete this whole i18n/ directory and the two
i18n steps in package.json to turn translation off: nothing else in the
English keeps the root, so every URL that ranks today is untouched. Each
other language lives under its own prefix: /es/about/ for /about/.
reviewed=false means the language is live for visitors through the switcher
but carries noindex and stays out of the sitemaps, so Google only ever sees
a language a person has actually read. Google's spam policy names machine
translation published without human review as scaled content abuse, and the
penalty lands on the whole domain, not on one language. Flip it to true the
day a native speaker has been through the pages.
`site` must match the `site` in astro.config.mjs: the alternate and
canonical URLs are built from it.
